task_summary: Completed server-enforced scheduled submission deadline policy and assigned Gantt edit permissions as part of the synthetic capstone workflow closure.
key_decisions: Resolve a section-specific MilestoneDeadline before the batch default, then fall back to the project deadline only when no scheduler record exists.
Enforce allowLateSubmission and late justification in the submission service so the policy cannot be bypassed through direct API uploads.
Keep assigned-Adviser schedule editing separate from the Adviser-only Gantt approval action.
Update integration fixtures to follow existing phase, signature, publication, and committee-role gates without weakening those gates.
lessons_learned: Client deadline feedback is not an enforcement boundary; final papers and chapters must consult the configured scheduler policy at the upload service.
Legacy workflow fixtures should assert the current institutional guard when they omit its prerequisite evidence; they should not be changed to bypass the guard.
Visual review remains distinct evidence from passing component tests and requires an authenticated browser that can reach localhost.
open_threads: Complete Playwright visual review for deadline and Gantt surfaces in light/dark desktop/mobile; no screenshots were produced because the available browser bridge could not reach localhost.
The full client suite remains unverified after its 120-second watchdog and needs a bounded diagnostic before another attempt.
verification_notes: Focused client workflow tests passed 52/52; server scheduled deadline policy tests passed 3/3; submissions integration tests passed 67/67; Gantt client tests passed 21/21 and server permission tests passed 11/11. The full client suite and required Playwright visual review remain incomplete.
